task: Draft a loading screen heading, accessible status message, and brief caption for a fictional application restoring a large workspace. Explain what is happening without implying the process has stalled. Do not supply an estimated time or a cancel action because neither is available.

facts.text: The application is restoring a workspace saved in the previous session.
The restoration process reads project files from the local disk.
Restoration time depends on workspace size; no estimated time is available to the application.
The process cannot be cancelled once started.
The loading indicator is an indeterminate spinner with no percentage.

forbidden_additions: An estimated time or progress percentage when none is available.
A cancel action when cancellation is not supported.
Language that implies the process has stalled.
preserve: Restoring previous workspace as the described operation.
